p.title: v60.02 a chat figure is supported only for the subject it was given for
p.symptom: In a two-stock question the prompt held "NVDA … PER 28.4배" and "AMD … PER 41.2배"; the answer "AMD의 PER은 28.4배입니다" was published, because every figure of the injected material supported every sentence. "41.2배" in an answer also failed against "[EV/EBITDA] 41.2x" in the material.
p.root_cause: src/ai/response/publication.js read the reference text as one flat list of figures with no subject. The per-ticker blocks reach the reference text quarantined (buildAIUntrustedBlock writes each payload on one JSON-quoted line) and the ticker block has no blank line between tickers, so subject could not be read from blank-line blocks either. The written-figure pattern did not read an x glued to digits as a multiple.
p.fix: supportedNumbersFromText(text, { entities }) tags each figure with its subject: quarantined payloads are decoded and bound to their own payload, a section opened by a line starting with a ━ run (or, outside one, by a top-level bullet naming one subject) belongs to the one subject its first lines name, other text goes by blank-line block and then by line, and anything naming no or several subjects stays subject-free. figuresSupported limits a sentence (or each clause of a sentence naming several) that names one subject to that subject's and the subject-free figures. Typed evidence rows carry their ticker when it is a question subject. The unified chat passes its resolved tickers as meta.entities; the request pipeline hands them to publication with the ticker registry entries, and answerEntities gives each ticker its en, kr and alt names (leaving out a name that is another ticker). 41.2x reads as a multiple. Without entities the v60.01 rule is unchanged.
p.violated_rule: No invented numbers: a real number attached to the wrong subject is an invented claim.
p.prevention: ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check v60.02 block: unit sentences kept/removed with and without entities, the x multiple, typed rows, the injected two-ticker shapes wrapped through the real buildAIUntrustedBlock (every figure of each ticker block tagged to it, counts asserted), plan and fallback paths, registry names for bare tickers; pipeline-semantics v60.02 case proves meta.entities and the registry names reach publication.
p.verification: node scripts/ci-ai-intelligence-contract-check.mjs and node scripts/ci-pipeline-semantics-check.mjs pass; both fail on the base sources (13 and 1 failures).

changelog: **Chat figures belong to their subject ({P}):** a figure the model was given for one stock no longer supports a sentence about another ("AMD의 PER은 28.4배" from NVDA's block is removed); a figure written 41.2x in the data supports 41.2배 in the answer.
note: v60.02: chat figures checked per subject
